evidence: Core behaviour matches the reference: CSV rows keyed by filename_or_obj or index, no header, overwrite merge, and NIfTI paths <dir>/<base>/<base>_<postfix><ext> (monai/data/csv_saver.py:44-94, monai/data/nifti_saver.py:76-108).
TensorBoard 2-D, RGB, 3-D single-channel (_HW_0) and 4-D+ animated-GIF paths match the reference (monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py:135-170).
monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:67 logs 'saved all the model outputs as nifti files.', matching the reference.
Divergence 1: a 3-D array with zero channels raises IndexError at monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py:167-168, where the reference's loop is a no-op. This is an edge case only.

Divergence 2: CSV rows are written unsorted (monai/data/csv_saver.py:94). The original sorted them (base/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:72), and the reference also drops the sort. This is shared with the reference but is a removal relative to the original.
Divergence 3: the original's 'saved classification predictions' info log is dropped. The reference also drops it.
